key_finding_1: rank 2 is an ALGORITHMIC transport waste, not a roofline: ship_partial at GATHER_FACES=2 issues 2 NoC writes of 1024 B per tile-row = 16 writes / 16 kB per member per round to carry 8 rows x 32 fp32 = 1 kB of information. 16x byte amplification in sub-efficient 1024-B chunks (~13 GB/s effective).
key_finding_2: the ROOT core is COMPUTE-SATURATED (zones sum to 32799 of its 33856 wall, no idle) while every MEMBER idles ~22 us in writer_mcast_recv / compute_scale cb_wait_front. The wall IS the root s serial work. Rebalancing off the root is therefore a first-class lever alongside making the fold cheaper.
key_finding_3: D22 s raw fold uses EXPLICIT tile indices (add_tiles(cb,cb,i,j,0)), so the row-major gather layout comment claiming a slot-major stride is inexpressible is STALE post-D22 — a strided fold is expressible, which unlocks a coalesced contiguous gather write.

verdicts.domain: correct everywhere, measured-regression everywhere. MECHANISM (refutes the first-order rebalance estimate): the rebalance SUCCEEDED (fold 13400 n=4 on one core -> 7476 n=1 on each of four; per-core KERNEL equalized 33.6/34.1 -> 37.3/37.4) but equalized ABOVE the fixed root s level. cross_agent_findings: Two subagents independently CONFIRMED the coordinator s stale-comment finding: rms_norm_writer.cpp:293-296 claims a slot-major gather is a gapped window no chain walk can express — true of the pre-D22 eltwise_chain, FALSE of D22 s explicit-index raw fold. One of them then refuted the idea it unlocked, on a control.

THE ROUND S BEST NEGATIVE RESULT: transaction count is NOT the gather s constraint. rm_f4 vs sm_f4 — identical bytes, BLOCK_ROWS transactions vs ONE — is flat within +-1% across 11 geometries. The coordinator s own 13 GB/s small-transfer premise was WRONG; it is D13 s byte bound. Compaction wins because it moves 8x fewer BYTES, not because it issues fewer writes.

A FOURTH instance of this op s pcc-blind failure pattern: gather_slot_major_coalesce s deliberate falsification (writer slot-major vs compute row-major) measured pcc 0.999564 / rel-RMS 2.892e-02 — INSIDE both the 0.9995 pcc gate AND the 0.04 rel-RMS bound. Only bit-exactness caught it. Any gather-layout change must be gated on bit-exactness.

Two subagents had to PORT D22 into their bench before their verdict was trustworthy; one found its first baseline carried the pre-D22 D16 fold (23502 ns of fold payload vs the op s 11297) and that the stale baseline REVERSED its mcast conclusion. Inheriting a prior round s bench baseline is a real hazard.

sharpest_hazard: D27 s finalize needs a WIDER VectorMode scope and this is a CORRECTNESS change, not a perf one. D17 s shipped <2,4> C reaches only columns 0,2..14 and is silently wrong on a compact tile from BLOCK_ROWS=2: measured pcc 0.9972987 with rel-RMS 1036 against a 0.04 bound — the FOURTH bug in this op that pcc alone would have passed. Compact gets <1,8> C (BR<=16) / <1,8> RC (above); D17 s narrow scope STAYS for the local non-combine finalize. The bench keeps it as a live assertion (test_finalize_scope_hazard) that FAILS if the narrow scope ever starts passing.
deferred_with_numbers: gather_dual_noc s mc/mcs (mcast -> NoC0): 1.448x/1.363x on TRANSPORT but 0.912x/0.917x on the wall because the mcast was hidden behind the root chain. Its author s note was re-measure if a sibling shrinks the root chain — D27 shrank it 9.4x and this was NOT re-measured. Most likely live lever left in the combine.

one combine round at the focus geometry: L1-infeasible by a MEASURED 48 kB. Two named unmeasured levers: _cb_block_mult over-counts cb_x_squared as block_rows*wt_chunk where D12 s DEST fold allocates only block_rows, and cb_row_final/cb_sum_handoff are CB_ROW_STAT_DEPTH*block_rows.
D27 s 12-row ragged tail pays the RC finalize scope because the cap comes from BLOCK_ROWS (20>16) not the round s actual rows. Correct superset, measured flat ~452 ns/round.
methodological_findings: A tournament that reports an isolated stage number as the op s number is lying. D28 s isolated 1.40-1.45x became 1.03-1.08x for two ARITHMETIC reasons, both recorded at the constants: the bench s flat baseline still paid boot-zero calls a SIBLING graduation (D26) had since deleted, and the combine is ~1.5-2 us of a 5-5.4 us op on a ~3.5 us dispatch floor.

Both REGRESSIONS refuted a premise the COORDINATOR had written into the brief, on a control rather than an argument. gather_slot_major_coalesce killed the 13 GB/s small-transfer premise with rm_f4 vs sm_f4 (identical bytes, BLOCK_ROWS txns vs ONE, flat within +-1% across 11 geometries): transaction count is not the constraint, the root s L1 ingress BYTES are. root_rotation refuted the first-order rebalance estimate BY SUCCEEDING at the rebalance and equalizing ABOVE the fixed root s level — D24 makes the fixed root a broadcast latency ahead of its group, so its fold runs in slack; rotation cannot shorten a serial chain by moving a link.

Perf 1 and Perf 2 both recorded compaction and hierarchical gather as MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE. REFUTED: the exclusivity was the ROW-SPLIT half s. The SLOT tree parallelises over GROUP_SIZE, an axis compaction does not touch, and their measured domains are DISJOINT (BLOCK_ROWS>1 vs BLOCK_ROWS==1 with GROUP_SIZE>=30). Both graduated on one code path.

A FIFTH instance of this op s pcc-blind pattern, and it should become policy: a deliberate falsification (writer slot-major vs compute row-major) measured pcc 0.999564 / rel-RMS 2.892e-02 — INSIDE both the 0.9995 pcc gate AND the 0.04 rel-RMS bound. Only BIT-EXACTNESS caught it. Any future gather-layout change should be gated on bit-exactness.

probes/zone_percore.py --has ZONE was the round s most load-bearing tooling change: ranking cores by KERNEL wall surfaces only the combine s IDLE MEMBER cores, so the ROOT — the core the critical path actually runs on — is otherwise unreachable.
